definition: Documented family money, safety, business platform, or resource support that materially extended early experimentation.
zero_means: No clear documented advantage in reviewed sources; not proof of poverty or absence.
maximum_means: Unusually strong financial, corporate, celebrity, or resource platform.
caution: Sensitive and frequently under-documented. Prefer two strong sources for score 2.

definition: Relevant knowledge, coaching, equipment access, or industry fluency transferred by parents or close family.
zero_means: No clear relevant family-domain transfer documented.
maximum_means: Direct apprenticeship or unusually relevant expert family environment.
caution: Do not infer expertise from occupation title alone.

definition: Pre-existing audience, brand, corporate platform, investor network, or high-status access available before personal market proof.
zero_means: No clear inherited distribution or business network documented.
maximum_means: Large, directly usable platform or exceptional network.
caution: Separate inherited access from networks earned through later work.

definition: Selective school, university, lab, employer, accelerator, academy, or national pipeline that concentrated opportunity.
maximum_means: Highly selective and materially catalytic pipeline.
caution: Institution attendance alone does not prove causality.

definition: Physical or social proximity to an emerging technological, cultural, commercial, or performance frontier.
maximum_means: Direct immersion in the wave's densest early ecosystem.
caution: Use contemporaneous context, not hindsight alone.

definition: Unusually early access to scarce computers, labs, studios, equipment, academies, or other high-value infrastructure.
maximum_means: Access was exceptionally scarce for the time and enabled substantial early repetition.
caution: Judge rarity relative to place and era.

definition: A high-quality adult supplied sustained, individualized feedback or opportunity.
maximum_means: Long-running, unusually capable mentor or coach materially accelerated progress.
caution: One meeting or famous introduction is not sustained mentorship.

definition: A high-trust peer, sibling, cofounder, or collaborator multiplied learning and execution.
zero_means: No meaningful collaborator documented at the relevant stage.
maximum_means: Durable and strongly complementary collaborator or peer group.
caution: Team size is not team quality.

definition: Early use of an online platform or community for learning, feedback, reputation, or distribution.
maximum_means: Platform or community was central to learning and distribution.
caution: Distinguish casual use from a repeatable channel.

definition: Direct immersion in the customer problem, profession, or domain before the breakout.
zero_means: Distant or abstract relationship to the problem.
maximum_means: Deep lived or repeated operational exposure.
caution: This score was generously coded in v0.1 and should receive special audit attention.

definition: Unusually high early cognitive, creative, or physical ability that changed access and response from institutions.
maximum_means: Clear prodigy-level or elite physical ability documented.
caution: Avoid retroactively labelling every successful person a prodigy.

definition: Hardship, outsider status, health, language, or institutional friction that created urgency or a distinctive problem lens.
maximum_means: Major constraint was central to the path.
caution: Adversity is not an advantage in itself and should not be romanticized.
